SUMMARY.md: Nakamoto Notes' open Bitcoin Barometer feed: a composite 0-100 Heat Score and zone describing Bitcoin's market-cycle position against history (not a price forecast). Keyless; documented limit 10 requests per minute, responses cached 5 minutes, HTTP 503 instead of a number when a reading cannot be produced. Licence CC BY 4.0 (attribute NakamotoNotes). Built from https://nakamotonotes.com/open and live probes on 2026-10-23; the live payload carries undocumented price, indicatorHeats, zoneBands and searchInterest fields. Omitted: barometer-history.csv (daily date,score,zone CSV), rss.xml, and the MCP server. Unverified: the item type of `degraded` (only an empty list seen) and the 503 body.
Zone for the score: Chill, Neutral, Heated or Euphoric.
